title.en: Spirit Conduit Loa Powers Can No Longer Be Used on Kindo'jan - Patch 12.1.5 Hotfixes
title.es: Spirit Conduit Loa Powers ya no se puede usar en Kindo'jan - Parche 12.1.5 Correcciones en Vivo (Hotfixes)

summary.en: Spirit Conduit Loa Powers Can No Longer Be Used on Kindo'jan - Patch 12.1.5 Hotfixes...
summary.es: Spirit Conduit Loa Powers ya no se puede usar en Kindo'yan - Parche 12.1.5 Correcciones en Vivo (Hotfixes)...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has posted hotfixes for today, which prevent Spirits Conduits from being used on the Kindo'jan encounter.

Spirit Conduits are unlocked at Renown 6 of the Labyrinth of Kindo-jan Renown track and grant short 2 minute buffs. One of the strategies that players were using was to leave all the conduits untouched until Kindo-jan was summoned, then quickly pick them all up and absolutely destroy Kindo'jan with a lot of damage. This will no longer work according to the hotfixes.

Labyrinth of Kindo'jan


For End-Game Gearing
  • Crests have been uncapped.
  • Ascendant Venomstones have been unlocked.
  • Conquest and Bloody Tokens are now uncapped.
For Everyday Players
  • Blizzard has fixed another bugged scenario in Labyrinths
  • The Spirit Conduits cannot be used on Kindo-jan.
  • Various questing bugs were fixed.
Blizzard
View Original
Here you'll find a list of hotfixes that address various issues related to World of Warcraft: Midnight, Mists of Pandaria Classic, Season of Discovery, Burning Crusade Classic, WoW Classic Era, and Hardcore. Some of the hotfixes below take effect the moment they were implemented, while others may require scheduled realm restarts to go into effect. Please keep in mind that some issues cannot be addressed without a client-side patch update. This list will be updated as additional hotfixes are applied.

Hotfixes

October 20, 2026

Achievements
  • The availability of Fabled: Let Me Solo Him: Kindo'jan has been extended and can now be earned until weekly maintenance during the week of October 27.
Labyrinth
  • Fixed an issue that could sometimes prevent the “Fools and Curses” scenario from completing.
  • Fixed an issue where Spirit Conduit Loa powers could be used during Kindo'jan's fight.
Items
  • Mistcrests are now uncapped.
  • Ascendant Venomstones are now available after completing the quest “Ascending with Venomstones”.
  • The Ancient Hash'ey Battle Art glove enchantments can now be applied to Warbound Until Equipped items.
  • The Void Eruption effect on Kith'ix's armor pieces can no longer hit targets you aren't in combat with.
Player versus Player
  • Conquest and Bloody Tokens are now uncapped.
  • The Spoils of War buff is now available – Conquest gains increased by 50% and Honor gains increased by 40% in Battlegrounds and Arenas.
  • The Venomous Equipment Chest is now available for purchase from the conquest quartermaster, Irissa Bloodstar.
Quests
  • The furbolgs required for the quest "Not Quite Nalorakk" have returned from their hibernation.
  • Fixed an issue where spending Nebulous Voidcores on non-raid sources would not grant credit towards completing the "A Nebulous Endeavour" tutorial quest. This objective will be completed the next time a character spends a Nebulous Voidcore on any Season 2 bonus roll source.
  • Resolved an issue where the Skardyn Behemoth could become unattackable, preventing completion of "Draw Its Ire."
  • Fixed an issue that prevented the completion of the Voidstorm quest "To Be Changed".

title.en: Turn Restored Coffer Keys into Ascendant Venomstones by Doing Tier 11 Delves
title.es: Convierte las llaves de cofre restauradas en piedras de veneno ascendentes haciendo profundizaciones de nivel 11

summary.en: Turn Restored Coffer Keys into Ascendant Venomstones by Doing Tier 11 Delves...
summary.es: Convierte las llaves restauradas del cofre en piedras de veneno ascendentes haciendo profundizaciones de nivel 11...

contentHtml:
If you have a lot of Restored Coffer Keys, you can turn them into Ascendant Venomstones by opening Bountiful Chests from Tier 11 Delves and Labyrinths.

Ascendant VenomstonesLabyrinth of Kindo'jan

Restored Coffer Keys

Players can earn up to 600 Coffer Key Shards a week, or 6 Restored Coffer Keys by default. In addition, Naleidea Rivergleam sells 2 more Coffer Keys each week. This means that you can get up to 8 Coffer Keys or 8 Ascendant Venomstones this week by completing Delves on Tier 11.

In Midnight Season 1, players could only acquire a limited amount of Ascendant Venomstone from Delves each day due to the limited number of Bountiful Delves. In Midnight Season 2, Labyrinths offer unlimited runs, allowing you to turn your Restored Coffer Key into Ascendant Venomstones as many times as you want.

 


If you have a lot of Coffer Keys, this is an efficient method of getting Ascendant Venomstones!

Bountiful Delves

There are only 4 Bountiful Delves up per day, which allows you to convert 4 Keys into Ascendant Venomstones by opening the Tier 11 Bountiful chest at the end.

If you want to be more efficient, if you find Dundun inside the Delve once a week, he will make your Delve Abundant and grant you an extra chest, which can turn one extra Restored Coffer Key into Ascendant Venomstone.

 


If you're having trouble finding Dundun in a delve, use the macro to help and talk to him!

/target dundun
/ping [@target] assist
 

Labyrinth

You can complete the Labyrinth of Kindo'jan as many times as you want, and a full clear gets you 3 chests. This allows you to convert 3 Coffer Keys into 3 more Ascendant Venomstones!

If you have a backlog of Restored Coffer Key and want more Ascendant Venomstones, it may be time to spam some Labyrinths.

title.es: Cómo reservar tu nombre de personaje de World of Warcraft: Forever el 27 de octubre

summary.en: How to Reserve Your World of Warcraft: Forever Character Name on October 27th...
summary.es: Cómo reservar tu nombre de personaje de World of Warcraft: Forever el 27 de octubre...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has revealed how players can reserve their character names in World of Warcraft: Forever on October 27th!

Starting on October 27th at 1:00 PM PDT, eligible players can create and reserve up to three characters across all the Rulesets!
Blizzard
View Original
Early Name Reservations for World of Warcraft: Forever are available from 27 October through 3 November, giving players an opportunity to secure the names that will become part of their adventures in Azeroth.

Name Reservation Start Times

  • Europe: 27 October at 18:00 CET
  • North America: 27 October at 13:00 PDT
  • Korea: 28 October at 07:00 KST
  • Taiwan: 28 October at 07:00 CST
During the reservation period, eligible players* can create and reserve names for up to three characters total across all Rulesets. This means that if you create two on a PvP Ruleset, you’ll only be able to create one more character in a Normal or Role-Play Ruleset. This restriction only applies to Early Name Reservation.

Prepare to Launch

  1. Make sure your graphics drivers are up to date.
  2. Download and install the Battle.net desktop app
  3. Open the Battle.net desktop app and allow it to update if needed.
  4. Select World of Warcraft from the list of games.
  5. In the Game Version menu above the Play button, select World of Warcraft: Forever, then select Install.
  6. Once installation is complete select Play and choose your Ruleset.
  7. Create up to 3 characters with your chosen name.
Choose the names that will carry your heroes into a new age and prepare for your adventures in World of Warcraft: Forever.
Players who pre-purchase the Skyborne Heroic Pack, Skyborne Epic Pack, or limited-time Warcraft Forever Collection will have access to WoW®: Forever Early Name Reservation from 27 October through 3 November. Character names will be available on a first-come, first-served basis, and desired names cannot be guaranteed.

For additional information on how character names work, check out the previously published Create a Name of Your Own in WoW: Forever article.

* Purchase of World of Warcraft: Forever Digital Upgrade or Collector’s Edition required. This benefit only applies to the specific WoW® account it was purchased for. WoW®: Forever Early Name Reservation will be available starting October 27 through November 3. Character names are limited to a first-come, first-serve basis, and desired names cannot be guaranteed.

summary.es: Blizzard anuncia la fecha de cierre y la extensión de WoW: Forever Beta...

contentHtml:
The World of Warcraft: Forever Beta has been extended an extra two days and will be going offline on Friday, October 23rd.

The WoW: Forever Beta has entered its final week, with the original closing date of the Beta being October 21st. In a new Blue Post, Blizzard has extended the WoW: Forever Beta an extra two days, and announced the new closing time of Friday, October 23rd at 10:00 AM Pacific time.

As the Forever Beta has now been extended past Thursday, it's possible that we get to see one more Beta build before the servers go down.
Blizzard
View Original
We plan to close the WoW Forever Beta … forever at 10:00 a.m. PDT on Friday, October 23.

Thank you very much for joining us. We’ll see you there!

title.en: Nightmare Preys Hotfixed and Are Fastest Source of Ascendant Venomstones
title.es: Las presas de pesadilla se reparan y son la fuente más rápida de piedras venenosas ascendentes

summary.en: Nightmare Preys Hotfixed and Are Fastest Source of Ascendant Venomstones...
summary.es: Las presas de pesadilla se arreglaron y son la fuente más rápida de piedras venenosas ascendentes...

contentHtml:
Nightmare Prey now correctly drops Ascendant Venomstones and using the Soul Consumables makes Prey the fastest source of them!

Season 2 Delves GuidePrey Guide

Ascendant Venomstones from Prey

When the NA servers went live earlier today, Kith'ix and Nightmare Prey did not drop Ascendant Venomstones. This now appears to have been fixed, and your first two Nightmare Preys a week will grant you a Preyhunter's Champion Chest, containing a Ascendant Venomstone.

Soul Consumables

If you've been doing Prey content during Season 2, you probably have unlocked the Afflicted Soul and Tormented Soul items. These drop from Delves and instantly summon the boss during a Nightmare Prey, while also granting a bonus Preyhunter's Champion Chest or Preyhunter's Hero Chest chest on completion.

Afflicted Soul
Item Level 1
Binds to Warband
Use: Your next Nightmare difficulty Prey hunt immediately discovers where the target is hiding and awards a bonus Preyhunter's Champion Chest.

Note: You must not be on an active hunt to use this item. (10 Min Cooldown)
Requires Level 90
Max Stack: 200
Tormented Soul
Item Level 1
Binds to Warband
Use: Your next Nightmare difficulty Prey hunt immediately discovers where the target is hiding and awards a bonus Preyhunter's Hero Chest.

Note: You must not be on an active hunt to use this item. (10 Min Cooldown)
Requires Level 90
Max Stack: 200


These bonus chests always drop one Preyhunter's Champion Chest, allowing you to get one bonus Ascendant Venomstone for very little work! If you use a soul consumable and it's one of your first two Nightmare Preys of the week, congratulations on two easy Ascendant Venomstones in about a minute.


2 Ascendant Venomstones for just over a minute of work.


The only downside is that there is a limited number of Ascendant Venomstones available from Prey. You have a maximum of 2 Nightmare Preys that drop Venomstones directly and limited by the number of soul consumables that you have. However, these items are Warbound, so you can send them over from other characters.

title.es: [Actualizado] Piedras venenosas ascendentes detectadas y que no caen de fuentes de Blizzard

summary.en: [Updated] Ascendant Venomstones Bugged and Not Dropping from Blizzard Noted Sources...
summary.es: [Actualizado] Piedras de veneno ascendentes grabadas y no saliendo de fuentes de Blizzard...

contentHtml:
Ascendant Venomstones are now available and players have noticed that some drop sources are bugged and not dropping them.

Hotfixes have gone out that fix the issues. The original article has been left below for archival purposes, but we've added a new section above with the list of drop sources.

How to Farm Ascendant Venomstones

After the hotfixes, make sure you turn in the Ancient Depths, Ancient Venom quest at the Silvermoon Catalyst and then Ascendant Venomstone drop from:
  • Tier 11 Bountiful Delve Chests (Need Keys)
  • 3 Per Full Clear of Tier 11 Labyrinth (Need Keys)
  • Heroic Nymrissa Wavecaller
  • Heroic Kith'ix
  • Heroic Venomous Abyss bosses
  • First 2 Nightmare Prey Runs of the Week
  • Bonus Chests from Afflicted and Tormented Souls on Nightmare Prey
  • Mythic+ 10 or higher.

Original Article

If you've completed the Ancient Depths, Ancient Venom quest, Orin Straylight at the Silvermoon Catalyst will grant you the Ascending with Venomstones quest, which can be turned in immediately. This will unlock Ascendant Venomstone across your Warband and give you your first Ascendant Venomstone, but can only be completed once per account.

 


Blizzard described how to get Ascendant Venomstones in their official Patch Notes.
Blizzard
View Original
Completing this quest will empower defenders of the realm to acquire Ascendant Venomstones, which drop from every Heroic or Mythic raid boss, Mythic+ Keystone dungeons at +10 and above, Tier 11 Bountiful Delves, and Nightmare Prey Hunt Champion gear chests.
Players have now discovered that some of these sources are not currently dropping Venomstones as intended:
  • Nightmare Prey Hunt Champion gear chests are NOT dropping Ascendant Venomstones.
  • Heroic Kith'ix is NOT dropping Ascendant Venomstones.
We've confirmed that the following are dropping Ascendant Venomstones:
  • Tier 11 Bountiful Delve Chests (includes Labyrinth ending)
  • Heroic Nymrissa Wavecaller
  • Heroic Venomous Abyss bosses
